test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ________ of trade refers to the type of goods and services a country exports and imports.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Composition.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** composition of trade refers to the types of goods and services a country exports and imports.**
 
• It encompasses the** variety and complexity of products and services exchanged in international trade.**
 
• The composition can be determined by **various factors, including a country's resources, technological capabilities, industrial structure, and policies.**
 
• It reflects a **country's economic strength and competitiveness on the global stage.**
 
• Countries with a** diverse trade composition are usually more resilient to economic shocks because they don't rely on a single type or category of goods for their export earnings.**
 
• Over time, the **composition of trade can change as a country develops, diversifies its economy, or adopts new technologies.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Factors
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Volume
 
 
 
• The volume of trade refers to the quantity of goods and services traded.
 
• It doesn't tell us anything about the types of goods and services being exchanged, just the amount.
 
 
 
 

 Value
 
 
 
• The value of trade refers to the monetary worth of goods and services traded.
 
• It tells us about the total dollar value of the exports and imports, but not specifically about the types of goods and services.
 
 
 
 

 Gain
 
 
 
• The gain from trade refers to the net benefit or advantage that a country gets from participating in international trade.
 
• This could be economic (increased income, jobs), social (access to diverse goods), or strategic.
 
• It doesn't refer directly to the types of goods and services a country exports and imports.
